About.title: Pioneers in Business AI in the Americas
About.description: Founded with the vision of democratizing access to artificial intelligence, Altum IA has become the strategic partner of leading companies across the continent. Our multidisciplinary team combines technical expertise with a deep understanding of the region's business challenges.

history.title: Our History
history.paragraph1: Our journey began in Colombia in early 2025, with the mission of applying artificial intelligence to solve complex business challenges in the region.
history.paragraph2: Driven by early success, two of our founding partners ventured to explore the North American market, establishing a solid presence in Canada. This strategic move allowed us to expand our brand in the world's second-largest country and bring our innovative solutions to a new and diverse market.
history.paragraph3: Simultaneously, to strengthen our reach throughout Latin America, another of our partners settled in Mexico. From there, we lead our expansion into Mexico and Central America, creating a strategic hub to serve our clients and consolidating our position as leaders in AI implementation across the continent.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To see more productive companies, with an orderly transition implementing AI in their operations.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To be the allies of companies in the countries where we operate, democratizing the implementation of top-level technology, with standards and under regulation.
